basis: Stratified audit of the C3-d final expansion under the R9 protocol, as applied to TASK-OPI-b6271546-41b0-4bbe-90ac-d522d8429f92.7's review phase: 12 of the 18 new entities sampled across the five capability groups (at least two each: topic-shift 3, hedged-opinion 2, backchannel 3, ask-clarification 2, soften-disagreement 2) plus the four C3-c entities the c3-c review had deliberately left out of its formal sample (res-pragmatic-that-makes-sense, res-pragmatic-could-you-say-that-again, res-pragmatic-got-it, res-pragmatic-with-all-due-respect — this review re-audited them on both faces) plus three legacy controls. All 19 audited entities PASS both faces: the content-linguistics face (typical_errors genuine; every POSITIVE_ERROR row instantiates a declared error_pattern in genuine learner-error English such that a reasonable implementation of the declared detection_rules matches it; boundary rows honest) and the mapping_class face (REALIZES + CURRICULUM_MAPPING follows the capability functional_definition entry by entry; the near-boundary items no-way / go-on / im-not-convinced / come-again / right each cite and refute the applicable does_not_count entry and pin the rival reading in a boundary fixture). The six unsampled new entities (res-hedge-from-what-i-can-tell, res-hedge-if-you-ask-me, res-pragmatic-what-was-that, res-pragmatic-run-that-by-me-again, res-pragmatic-youre-kidding, res-pragmatic-thats-debatable) are deliberately not approved here (strict over lenient). Landed by the C3-d disposition cut from the reviewer's verdict table; the reviewer itself stayed read-only.
